title: A Table for Strangers
description: Rowan wants enough simple food prepared for the next people stranded by the fracture.
completion_text: Rowan sees that this town has another person willing to look after newcomers.

stages.title: A Table for Strangers
stages.lead: Craft bread for a welcome meal, then ask Rowan who it is for.
notes: A personal request from Rowan. The quest is only offered through their friendship dialogue.

objectives.description: Ask Rowan about welcoming newly arrived travellers.
